written.headline: Nothing teases screenless AI hardware device launching in December
written.summary: Nothing CEO Carl Pei has teased the company's first AI-native hardware device ahead of a planned launch in December 2026. A teaser video shows a compact metallic gadget featuring two red and green LED lights, a physical button, and no display.

written.headline: Madras High Court rules AI-generated books violate library rules, orders FIR
written.summary: The Madras High Court ruled that AI-generated and plagiarised books fall under 'doubtful taste' and cannot be procured by public libraries. The court ordered the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption to immediately register an FIR regarding alleged fraudulent book purchases in Tamil Nadu.

written.headline: NHA selects EkaCare for AI Voice Scribe in public health facilities
written.summary: The National Health Authority selected health AI startup EkaCare as a technology partner for its ambient AI Voice Scribe solution in public health facilities. The tool converts doctor-patient conversations into structured clinical notes in Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources format across more than 15 Indian languages.

written.headline: AvenuesAI reports Q2 net profit of Rs 72 cr and 47% revenue surge
written.summary: Digital payments company AvenuesAI reported a 6% increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 71.7 crore for the September quarter of FY27. Revenue from operations rose 47% year-on-year to Rs 2,879.2 crore.

written.headline: US and China should stay clear-eyed on AI cooperation and competition, says Bessent
written.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that the US and China must navigate AI cooperation to mitigate risks while competing for supremacy. The two nations plan to advance a bilateral dialogue on superintelligence and establish an AI alert system.
